description: This source file defines the PromoteAdminController class within the Goteo project's administrative controller namespace. The class manages admin actions related to 'promote' nodes, including listing, deleting, and route definition for promotion-related endpoints.

classes.name: PromoteAdminController
classes.description: Controller handling administrative promotion-related actions such as listing, deleting, and route management in the Goteo platform.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name 'main' for this controller.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Defines and returns the routing map for promotion-related endpoints.

methods.name: validatePromote
methods.description: Validates the promotion ID and checks user permissions; throws exceptions if validation fails.

methods.name: showNodeAction
methods.description: Redirects administrator to the promote channel view for the current node.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Lists promote entries for a specified channel with pagination, handling node existence validation.

methods.name: deleteAction
methods.description: Deletes a promote entry after validation and reorder adjustment, then redirects to the channel list.
